title: The Wrong Classroom
genre: เรื่องเล่าขำ ๆ
text:
On my first day of university, I was (1) excited that I arrived thirty minutes early. I found Room 305, sat in the front row and (2) my notebook. Slowly the room filled with students, all of (3) looked much older than me. "They must (4) second-year students," I thought.
At nine o'clock, a woman walked in and wrote "Advanced Statistics" on the board. My heart stopped. My class was supposed to be "Introduction to Thai Culture." I was (5) embarrassed to stand up in front of everyone, so I stayed. For ninety minutes, I wrote down numbers and symbols (6) I did not understand at all.
At the end, the teacher asked (7) had any questions. I raised my hand. "Yes," I said. "Where is Room 503?" Everyone laughed, (8) the teacher. She told me I (9) read my timetable more carefully. I still have those notes. They remind me to check things twice (10) I panic.

items.stem: (1) On my first day of university, I was ___ excited that I arrived thirty minutes early.
why_wrong: such ต้องมีคำนาม
too … that ผิด
very … that ผิด

items.stem: (2) I found Room 305, sat in the front row and ___ my notebook.
why_wrong: open ไม่ขนาน
opening ไม่ขนาน
was opened = ถูกเปิด ผิด
items.explanation_th: found, sat and opened (V2 ขนาน)

items.stem: (3) Slowly the room filled with students, all of ___ looked much older than me.
why_wrong: หลังบุพบทใช้ who ไม่ได้
them ทำให้เป็นสองประโยคไม่มีคำเชื่อม
which ใช้กับสิ่ง
items.explanation_th: หลังบุพบท (all of) + คน → whom

why_wrong: must being ผิด
must been ผิด
must to be ผิด

items.stem: (5) I was ___ embarrassed to stand up in front of everyone, so I stayed.
why_wrong: such ใช้กับคำนาม
much embarrassed to ผิด
enough ต้องอยู่หลัง adj

items.stem: (6) For ninety minutes, I wrote down numbers and symbols ___ I did not understand at all.
why_wrong: what ไม่ขยายคำนาม
who ใช้กับคน
where ใช้กับสถานที่
items.explanation_th: ขยาย numbers and symbols (กรรมของ understand) → that

items.stem: (7) At the end, the teacher asked ___ had any questions.
why_wrong: what anyone had … ผิดโครงสร้าง
asked that ใช้กับคำถามไม่ได้
which anyone ผิด
items.explanation_th: asked whether anyone = ถามว่ามีใคร…ไหม

why_wrong: included the teacher ผิดโครงสร้าง
include ผิด
includes ผิด
items.explanation_th: including + คำนาม = รวมถึง

items.stem: (9) She told me I ___ read my timetable more carefully.
why_wrong: must have ความหมายผิด
can't have ความหมายผิด
needn't have ความหมายกลับ
items.explanation_th: ตำหนิ = ควรจะอ่านตารางให้ดี → should have read

items.stem: (10) They remind me to check things twice ___ I panic.
why_wrong: after ไม่สมเหตุผล
since ไม่สมเหตุผล
until ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: ตรวจสองรอบก่อนจะตกใจ → before
